evals.prompt: Create a C4 system context diagram in Draw.io and export an SVG for documentation.
evals.expected_output: Read diagram-type-routing, palette, layout, and mxgraph references, create editable .drawio source with unique IDs and orthogonal connectors, export SVG, render and visually inspect for overlap/clipping.
expectations: Produces editable .drawio source with unique node IDs and resolving edge references
Exports SVG from the exact final .drawio source
Visually inspects rendered output or reports missing renderer without claiming visual QA

evals.prompt: Update labels in an existing .drawio architecture diagram without breaking existing node IDs.
evals.expected_output: Preserve existing stable node/edge IDs and project palette tokens, validate XML, regenerate exports, and visually inspect the final rendered output.
expectations: Preserves existing node identifiers and project vocabulary
Regenerates exports after the final source edit
